facts.summary: No responses in frank relapse patients, enrollment suspended; cash runway into Q3 2023 · Phase 2 · MT-401 in post-transplant AML · not yet approved

evidence.summary: None of the frank relapse patients showed an objective response to therapy.
evidence.primary_endpoint_met: None of the frank relapse patients showed an objective response to therapy.
evidence.safety: the Data Monitoring Committee has reviewed the existing safety data and has not identified any concerns.
evidence.program_discontinued: Marker has suspended further enrollment of frank relapse patients while re-evaluating additional modifications for this patient cohort, including potentially higher cell doses.
